Hyatt opened Thompson Seville on 9 November 2026. It is the first Thompson hotel in Andalusia and the brand's second in Spain, after Thompson Madrid.

## A Modernist landmark on Plaza de la Concordia

The hotel occupies La Gavidia, a landmark building on Plaza de la Concordia, in the historic centre of Seville. Hyatt describes it as one of the few examples of Modernist architecture in the old town. Carlos Llansó of Exacorp One and Mario Ronquillo of Estudio 2RDIP led the transformation. The interiors are by Jorge Lozano and the team at Proyecto Singular, and the art programme was curated by Luisa Olazabal's studio, with works by Spanish artists including Kepa Garraza and Macarena Gross.

There are 101 rooms and suites, from city-view rooms to terrace suites and the signature Thompson Suite. Some open onto private terraces. Up on the roof, a bar and pool look over the old town, alongside an open-air fitness area. The hotel also has 240 square metres of event space across four rooms and an inner courtyard.

## Casa Mayo and the sherry hour

At street level, Casa Mayo is the hotel's restaurant, developed with Grupo Manolo Mayo, a family-run Andalusian group with roots going back to 1963. Designed by the architect Pablo Baruc, it has a central bar, a wine cellar, an open kitchen, a courtyard and a terrace over the square. The menu leans on rice dishes, tomatoes and almadraba bluefin tuna.

The Lobby Bar serves coffee, tapas and sherry-based cocktails. Every day from 6 to 7pm, "La Hora" pairs chilled sherries from Jerez with a seasonal bite. Neither Hyatt nor the trade press has disclosed the owner or the investment.

Olivier Rust is the General Manager. He says the team wants Thompson Seville to "feel part of that rhythm", the rhythm of the city.

## The signal

Thompson does not open Seville with a hotel restaurant but with a local family name. For lifestyle and luxury hotels in historic city centres, the bar, the restaurant and the rooftop are now the front door: they bring in the city first, and the guests follow.

Congratulations to Olivier Rust and the Thompson Seville team on the opening.
summary: Hyatt has opened Thompson Seville, 101 rooms and suites in the Modernist La Gavidia building on Plaza de la Concordia, with a rooftop pool and Casa Mayo, a restaurant created with Grupo Manolo Mayo.
